resources.string: Not affiliated with M-Vave. Though this utility makes every attempt to correctly reset and safely flash your device, flashing custom firmware is at your own risk.

If your FM-1 won\'t start, some firmwares can start it in USB recovery mode if you hold down the “OCT−” key while switching it on. Then connect it and install a firmware you\'ve saved. Not every firmware does this, and if yours doesn\'t, recovery needs a computer: the app\'s settings say more.
You\'ll find this again in Settings.
